mechanism.claim: An unusually large completed one-session rotation in the direct Cboe VIX9D-to-VIX3M endpoint slope isolates repricing from immediate to quarterly equity volatility. During elevated BTC variation, rising short-end pressure maps short BTC and falling pressure maps long BTC for twenty-four hours after conservative next-session availability.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of delta log(VIX9D/VIX3M)
mechanism.why_distinct: CVCIR requires same-sign changes in both VIX9D/VIX and VIX/VIX3M plus elevated VIX; CVACR additionally requires VIX acceleration; static term candidates rank levels. CVDTSR uses only the direct endpoint-ratio first difference, admits internally offsetting component moves, has no VIX level or crypto-vol confirmation, and reuses no event/control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: direct slope rotation and completed prior-24h BTC variation must independently enter causal upper tails
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one delayed official daily external-volatility clock is absent from Gross9

features.surface: strictly ordered common Cboe observation dates with positive finite VIX9D_close and VIX3M_close
features.slope_rotation: current direct_slope minus immediately previous source observation direct_slope, strict nonzero
features.rotation_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(slope_rotation) over at most 252 valid observations, minimum 126, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.btc_variation: sum squared BTCUSDT one-minute log(close/open) over exact 24 elapsed hours ending at next source-session 09:30 ET decision
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid source decision ineligible

clock.decision: next Cboe observation date 09:30 America/New_York after source date
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent direct VIX9D/VIX3M endpoint slope rotation

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, slope, delay, rank, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
